description:
Drilling equipment is a critical component across both land and offshore markets, especially in mineral exploration, geothermal drilling, construction, and water well drilling. These drill rigs operate on every continent and play a vital role in shaping the future of energy and infrastructure development.

At OFS, we specialise in sourcing and supplying high-performance drilling equipment and spare parts trusted by industry leaders around the world. Our partnerships with OEMs known for rugged reliability and minimal maintenance allow us to provide top-tier equipment tailored for:

Auger Drilling
Wet Rotary Drilling
Core Drilling
Down-the-Hole Hammer Drilling

We support a wide range of drill rig models and applications, ensuring that our clients receive the exact components they need—on time and within budget.

What sets OFS apart is not only our product quality but also our unmatched MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Operations) support. Our experienced team ensures that your rigs remain operational, efficient, and productive, reducing downtime and increasing performance in the most demanding environments.

catalogItems.title: Draw Works
catalogItems.description: Draw works is the main hoisting system in rotary drilling rigs, made up of the drum, brakes, transmission, and cathead. At OFS, we supply top-quality spare parts trusted across the domestic, Middle Eastern, and Southeast Asian markets. Our durable components ensure smooth drilling operations, and our responsive service ensures a streamlined procurement experience tailored to your needs.

catalogItems.title: Travelling Block
catalogItems.description: OFS supplies high-quality travelling blocks and spare parts from trusted manufacturers. These pulley systems are essential for lifting and lowering heavy loads in the wellbore. We also offer multiple sheave units and custom-engineered designs tailored to meet specific project needs, from standard models to fully bespoke solutions.

catalogItems.title: Coiled Tubing
catalogItems.description: OFS supplies stainless steel seamless and welded coiled tubing for petrochemical, oil & gas, natural gas, and geothermal industries. Available in nickel, titanium, duplex, and other special alloys, our tubing meets both standard and custom specifications, backed by extensive industry experience.

catalogItems.description: OFS offers a full range of rugged and reliable oilfield instruments—from pressure gauges to complete systems—designed for today’s toughest drilling environments. We help you select cost-effective, high-quality tools, backed by dedicated support.

catalogItems.description: Wireline equipment uses braided and electrical cables for well intervention, evaluation, and maintenance in oil and gas operations. catalogItems.description: Completion tools are used to bring oil and gas wells into production after drilling. They support safe and efficient hydrocarbon extraction during well completion. OFS offers a full range of completion tools, including open-hole and cemented multi-stage stimulation systems, composite plugs, and critical components like wellheads, tubing hangers, safety valves, ESPs, and more—ensuring reliable performance from test to commercial production.

catalogItems.title: Oil Tools
catalogItems.description: Oil tools are essential equipment used during drilling, completion, and well intervention activities to optimise production and maintain consistent reservoir flow. OFS supplies a range of downhole tools designed to reduce operational costs, extend well life, and improve oil recovery. These tools support operations like fishing, cementing, casing, well measurements, and reservoir fracturing, ensuring smooth and efficient well management.

catalogItems.title: Rock Tricone Drill Bit
catalogItems.description: OFS tricone drill bits deliver superior rock-cutting performance for mining and construction applications. Our range features multiple bearing types and specialized bit options, including high-speed steel, carbide, and diamond-enhanced designs for demanding geological conditions. Supported by comprehensive maintenance solutions and drilling accessories, OFS bits ensure optimal performance throughout their operational life.

catalogItems.title: Power Swivels
catalogItems.description: Power Swivels are hydraulic motor-driven machines used to rotate drill pipes during operations such as oil and gas well drilling, water wells, offshore platform piling, and foundation construction. OFS offers a wide range of high-performance power swivel systems, known for their safety, reliability, and adaptability to various drilling needs.

description: Transmitting electricity over long distances remains a critical engineering challenge. At OFS, we address this by focusing on four key pillars: Efficiency (Ensuring minimal energy loss during transmission to maximize power delivery across distances), Safety (Implementing systems that protect both people and the environment, especially in densely populated and sensitive areas), Cost (Reducing construction and operational expenses by optimizing raw material usage and infrastructure design), and Robustness (Designing resilient systems that withstand natural disruptions like lightning, solar flares, and storms, with self-healing capabilities to isolate faults and restore power quickly). description:
Industrial oils, chemicals, and lubricants play a critical role in the process industry. Industrial oils are used in a wide range of machinery and vehicles, available in various types such as gear oils, air compressor oils, hydraulic oils, rock drill oils, turbine oils, and low-toxicity oils.

Chemicals are often blended to enhance fuel efficiency and protect equipment from corrosion, contributing to improved performance and longevity.

Lubricants are essential for minimizing friction between moving surfaces—particularly in rotary equipment—ensuring smooth and efficient machinery operation. Commonly used lubricants include motor oils, marine oils, silicone-based lubricants, greases, turbine oils, metalworking fluids, cutting and grinding fluids, farming oils, gas engine oils, brake fluids, and hydraulic oils.

catalogItems.title: Lubricating Grease
catalogItems.description: Lubricating grease is a semi-solid lubricant made by blending mineral oil with a soap-based thickener. Unlike liquid lubricants, it doesn't flow easily, which allows it to cling effectively to moving parts. Its consistency makes it easy to apply, provides excellent sealing capabilities, and ensures long-lasting performance. Due to its reliability and versatility, lubricating grease is widely used across industries such as construction, agriculture, oil and gas, and chemical processing.

catalogItems.title: Grease Gun
catalogItems.description:
OFS offers a comprehensive selection of grease guns designed for professional lubrication applications. Our range includes:

Lever-operated models for heavy-duty use
Pistol grip designs for enhanced control
Hand grip options for precision applications

We understand that proper lubrication requires the right tools. That's why our grease guns are engineered to deliver precise amounts of lubrication - typically 1-3 grams per stroke - ensuring optimal performance while minimizing waste.

Plug, Check & Needle Valves for backflow prevention and fine-tuned control
Actuated Control, Solenoid, Safety & Pneumatic Valves for automated protection

description: Industrial valves play a crucial role across all sectors of the manufacturing industry, particularly in oil and gas, chemical processing, and water management systems. At OFS, we supply a wide range of industrial valves designed to handle various pressure levels and flow requirements. Our valves are suitable for controlling the movement of gases, liquids, and semi-solids, offering reliable solutions for diverse industrial applications.

catalogItems.title: Ball Valve
catalogItems.description: A ball valve provided by OFS is designed to regulate the flow of liquids and gases efficiently. It is available in various body constructions, including one-piece, two-piece, three-piece, and flanged designs. Known for its quick operation, the valve only requires a quarter-turn of the actuator, allowing for instant on/off control. OFS ball valves are built for long-term durability, crafted from robust materials to ensure reliable performance even under demanding conditions.

catalogItems.title: Gate Valve (Also known as a Sluice Valve)
catalogItems.description:
One of the most widely used valves across industries, the OFS gate valve serves as a reliable on/off switch to start or stop fluid flow. We provide a diverse range of gate valves, including screwed, union, bolted-bonnet, welded-bonnet, and pressure-seal designs.

Operating the valve is simple—turning the wheel raises or lowers the gate, controlling the flow of liquids and gases. While it can assist in fluid regulation, its primary function is to either fully open or completely shut off the flow, making it ideal for isolation applications. OFS gate valves are engineered for durability and precision, ensuring optimal performance in demanding environments.

catalogItems.title: Butterfly Valve
catalogItems.description:
OFS provides a versatile range of butterfly valves designed for various applications, including chemical processing, HVAC systems, water distribution, agriculture, and heavy industrial plants. These valves feature a compact, rotating circular disk that efficiently regulates flow while maintaining a low-profile design—ideal for installations in tight or confined spaces.

Engineered for reliability and ease of operation, OFS butterfly valves ensure precise flow control with minimal pressure drop. Their lightweight yet durable construction makes them a cost-effective solution for both on/off and throttling applications across multiple industries.

catalogItems.title: Globe Valve
catalogItems.description:
The OFS provides globe valve that delivers precise flow control in pipelines, offering superior shut-off and throttling performance. Unlike ball valves, its unique design allows for fine-tuned regulation, making it ideal for applications requiring accurate flow adjustment.

Engineered for reliability and ease of maintenance, OFS globe valves are commonly used in:

• Fuel oil systems
• Cooling water circuits
• Turbine seals and vents

catalogItems.title: Plug Valve
catalogItems.description:
OFS delivers plug valves that offer reliable quarter-turn operation for instant, leak-proof flow control in demanding applications. Combining the quick action of ball valves with enhanced durability, these valves excel in petroleum pipelines, chemical plants, and industrial fluid systems.

Engineered for critical service, OFS plug valves maintain bubble-tight shutoff and smooth performance under high pressures while optimizing flow capacity.

catalogItems.title: Check Valve
catalogItems.description: The OFS delivers check valve that is an essential one-way valve designed to prevent backflow and protect equipment from damage. By automatically allowing forward flow while blocking reverse flow, it safeguards critical processes across various industries. Our valves are engineered to handle diverse media including liquids, gases, steam, condensate, and semi-liquids like slurries. With reliable performance and durable construction, OFS check valves ensure uninterrupted operation while maintaining system integrity in demanding applications.

catalogItems.title: Needle Valve
catalogItems.description: The OFS delivers needle valve that offers precise flow control for steam, oil, gas, air and other media. Its fine-threaded stem allows gradual flow adjustment, making it ideal for applications requiring accurate regulation at low flow rates. These compact valves excel in critical systems like vacuum equipment and gas lasers where meticulous control is essential. With its ability to provide smooth, incremental shut-off, the OFS needle valve ensures reliable performance in both industrial and precision instrumentation applications.

catalogItems.title: Actuated Control Valves
catalogItems.description: OFS provides actuated control valves that deliver precision flow regulation for specialized industrial applications, including corrosive liquid handling in chemical plants and critical processes in power transmission systems. These automated valves provide exceptional control accuracy, responding to precise pressure requirements to maintain optimal flow rates. Engineered for demanding environments, our actuated valves combine reliable performance with robust construction, ensuring safe and efficient operation in applications where manual control would be impractical or hazardous. The OFS range offers customizable solutions tailored to meet exact process specifications across various industries.

catalogItems.title: Solenoid Valves
catalogItems.description: OFS provides solenoid valves to deliver automated, reliable flow control for diverse applications including heating systems, compressed air technology, industrial automation, and swimming pool systems. These electromechanically operated valves enable precise automatic regulation of liquid and gas flow, ensuring efficient system performance. Designed for both speed and durability, OFS solenoid valves offer rapid response times and long service life, making them ideal for applications requiring frequent cycling or remote operation. Their compact design and energy-efficient operation make them a versatile solution for modern fluid control systems across multiple industries.

catalogItems.title: Safety Valve (Also known as a Relief Valve)
catalogItems.description: The OFS provides safety valve that serves as the critical last line of defense for pressure protection systems. Designed to automatically release excess pressure caused by equipment failure or process disruptions, these valves safeguard critical infrastructure in chemical plants, gas storage facilities, and power generation boilers. Our safety valves combine fail-safe operation with precision engineering to maintain system integrity during overpressure events, preventing potential damage or hazardous situations. OFS offers reliable pressure relief solutions that meet stringent industry standards, ensuring optimal protection for your most valuable assets and processes.

catalogItems.title: Pneumatic Valve
catalogItems.description: OFS provides pneumatic valves to deliver precise control for compressed air systems, ensuring safe and efficient operation across industrial applications. These valves perform three critical functions: pressure regulation, flow control, and directional management of air flow. Available in various sizes and configurations, our pneumatic valves are engineered to meet specific application requirements, from light-duty automation to heavy industrial processes. With their reliable performance and quick response characteristics, OFS pneumatic valves optimize system efficiency while maintaining operational safety in demanding environments.

catalogItems.title: Pinch Valve
catalogItems.description: The OFS provides pinch valve as an ideal solution for handling abrasive and corrosive media, particularly in demanding slurry applications. Its simple yet effective design features a flexible sleeve that completely isolates the flow material from mechanical components, eliminating wear and ensuring long service life. As the most maintenance-friendly valve option, our pinch valves provide reliable shut-off even with particulate-laden flows while remaining lightweight for easy installation. OFS pinch valves deliver exceptional performance in mining, wastewater treatment, and chemical processing applications where traditional valves would fail.

catalogItems.title: Diaphragm Valve
catalogItems.description: The OFS provides diaphragm valve that combines versatility and hygiene for superior flow control in demanding applications. Its unique bidirectional design excels in both precise throttling and reliable on/off functions, making it ideal for industries requiring clean operation. The valve's maintenance-friendly construction allows for easy repairs without pipeline disruption, while its contaminant-free operation ensures product purity in food, pharmaceutical, and ultra-clean processes. OFS diaphragm valves deliver exceptional performance in corrosive, abrasive, or sterile applications where cleanliness and serviceability are paramount.

catalogItems.title: Electric Actuators
catalogItems.description: OFS provides electric actuators as a modern, efficient alternative to traditional hydraulic systems by delivering precise, programmable motion control through electric power. These self-contained units eliminate the complexity of hydraulic pumps and tubing while offering superior accuracy and repeatability. Their programmable nature allows for adaptable performance across diverse applications, from precision aerospace systems to industrial automation. With clean operation, reduced maintenance requirements, and the ability to integrate seamlessly with digital control systems, OFS electric actuators represent the future of motion control technology.

summary: Gas & steam turbines, industrial compressors, gearboxes, reciprocating & diesel engines, controls & instrumentation, and rotary equipment ancillaries.
keyPoints: Generating kinetic energy for fluid, gas & solid movement in industrial operations
Steam & gas turbine primary drivers, compressors, gearboxes & reciprocating engines
Strict safety adherence & regular maintenance ensuring reliable high-speed operation
Precision controls, instrumentation, seals & bearings tailored to client specifications
description:
Rotary equipment refers to mechanical systems that generate kinetic energy to enable movement within industrial operations. Common across the process industry, this category includes devices that move solids, liquids, or gases via a combination of drivers, driven components, and transmission mechanisms.

Rotating equipment is integral to operations involving steam and gas turbines. In such applications, steam turbines act as primary drivers—using high-pressure steam to power equipment like forced or induced-draft fans, pumps, and air compressors. Gas turbines, on the other hand, can either drive generators directly through compressed air or use “scoop tubes” in fluid couplings to transmit energy to rotating components.

Due to the high speeds and pressures involved, operating rotary equipment can pose significant risks. Therefore, strict adherence to safety procedures and regular maintenance are critical to ensure safe and efficient performance.

At OFS, we supply high-quality rotary equipment and components built to meet the rigorous demands of industrial environments—ensuring reliability, performance, and safety in every application.
